title: Guest Chat Values observer mistakes an open mobile sheet for a closed control
surface: Hosted native guest Chat acceptance observer
organization_context: No account token, profile, or organization
preconditions: Exact 0.2.522 Store candidate loaded unpacked under its Store identity on the guarded hosted B runner.
The narrow side panel renders the package's mobile ContextRulesChip BottomSheet.
reproduction: Run guarded hosted guest Chat acceptance 39058763654 against release artifact 39056398246.
Open the unique Values chip before the first Chat send.
Observe the Values sheet open in the failure screenshot while the observer reads null from the face button's aria-expanded and reports guest_values_chip_open_not_observed.
expected: The observer requires the unique Values panel to actually open and close, whether the package renders a mobile sheet or desktop popover, before it proceeds to the first Chat send.
actual: The mobile Values sheet opened visibly, but the observer waited for aria-expanded=true on a face button that has no aria-expanded in the mobile branch. It stopped before any composer input or Send click. This run gives no guest Chat acceptance credit and does not adjudicate the earlier no-send symptom.
reproducibility: Observed once on the exact hosted B run; a focused mobile-sheet driver fixture reproduces the wrong open assertion deterministically. A fresh native retest is pending.
severity: S2: false hosted failure blocks current guest Chat acceptance
priority: P1: repair before the next guarded guest Chat run
cause: The acceptance driver assumed the context chip always exposes aria-expanded. The shared ContextRulesChip uses a BottomSheet on mobile and does not set that attribute on its face button.
sibling_census: The reviewer/member Chat acceptance driver does not exercise this optional Values control. Other aria-expanded checks in browser tests target separate accordions and account controls, not this ContextRulesChip. The guest Values driver is the affected sibling class in this repo.
acceptance_criteria: Count only a unique open Values dialog with both the Send everything and Open full view controls; an unrelated dialog cannot satisfy the observer.
Close the sheet with Escape and verify the Values dialog disappears before composing a message.
Keep the real guest POST, independent same-conversation follow-up, and terminal assistant answer requirements unchanged.
Focused driver test fails against the old aria-expanded assumption and passes after repair; independent source review and native retest remain required.

source_verification.focused_red: guest_values_chip_open assertion failed on the mobile-sheet fixture before the repair
source_verification.focused_green: 9/9 guest Chat sequence tests pass after the repair
source_verification.native_acceptance: 39058763654 stopped before Send; fresh retest pending

next_action: Obtain independent review of the Values dialog selector, then run one guarded guest Chat acceptance against the same exact 0.2.522 artifact. Preserve the unresolved prior no-send investigation if it recurs.

transition_history.reason: Resource-valid hosted B run stopped at the optional Values open check while its screenshot showed the sheet open.
Confirmed the mobile BottomSheet branch lacks aria-expanded; focused driver fixture failed under the old oracle and passed after checking the actual open Values panel.
